title: DebateSpeechAnalysisV1
description: Structured schema for version 1 of AI-powered competitive debate speech analysis with explicit debate context and provenance evidence.

argument_analysis.description: Substantive claims and constructive arguments developed in the speech.

rebuttal_analysis.description: Assessment of engagements and responses to opposing arguments.

clash_analysis.description: Central points of disagreement in the debate and comparative weighing.

ObservationType.description: Explicit distinction between directly cited evidence and model inference/interpretation.

source.description: The origin of the evidence in relation to the debate round.

speaker_identifier.description: The speaker or role identifier associated with this excerpt (e.g. 'Speaker 1', 'Prime Minister', or specific speaker name).

speech_role.description: Debate role associated with the source speech if known (e.g. 'PM', 'DLO', 'MG').

quote.description: Verbatim transcript excerpt or verifiable textual reference.

start_time.description: Audio timestamp in seconds where the excerpt begins.

end_time.description: Audio timestamp in seconds where the excerpt ends.

notes.description: Additional context or provenance note regarding the quotation or timestamp.

target_speaker_name.description: Name or placeholder identifier of the evaluated speaker.

target_speech_role.description: The formal role/position of the speaker (e.g. '1st Proposition', 'Prime Minister', 'Opposition Whip').

motion.description: The motion debated in the round, if provided.

info_slide.description: Accompanying info slide or context slide, if provided.

context_completeness.description: Level of broader debate context supplied during analysis.

available_speech_roles.description: List of speeches in the debate for which transcript context was available.

model_identifier.description: Identifier of the model that generated this analysis.

claim.description: Summary of the core claim or proposition asserted.

reasoning.description: The substantive explanation, mechanism, or causal chain presented.

strengths.description: Analytical and persuasive strengths of this argument.

weaknesses.description: Vulnerabilities, unproven assumptions, or logical gaps.

unsupported_claims_or_gaps.description: Specific missing evidentiary links, mechanisms, or warrants identified.

target_argument.description: The opposing argument or case point targeted by the speaker.

target_speaker_or_side.description: Which opposing speaker or side advanced the argument.

engagement_type.description: Distinguishes substantive engagement from superficial referencing or mere mention.

response_summary.description: How the speaker answered or challenged the argument.

effectiveness.description: Assessment of the logical impact and execution of the rebuttal.

missed_rebuttal_opportunities.description: Readily identifiable opposing points or nuances that were unaddressed.

clash_theme.description: The underlying dispute or focal clash point across teams.

speaker_engagement.description: How the speaker positioned their side regarding this central dispute.

comparative_weighing.description: Use of weighing metrics (e.g. scale, reversibility, likelihood, vulnerability) to prove their side wins the clash.

unaddressed_dimensions.description: Facets of the clash where opposing framing or weighing went unanswered.

expected_responsibilities.description: Normative duties for this speech position in the stated format.

missing_or_insufficient_responsibilities.description: Duties omitted, underdeveloped, or improperly executed.

format_specific_notes.description: Contextual nuances (e.g. extension constraints in BP closing half, whips not creating new arguments).

organization_and_progression.description: How the speech was ordered (e.g. roadmap, sequencing from rebuttal to substantive).

clarity_and_coherence.description: Ease of following the line of argumentation.

transitions_and_signposting.description: Use of explicit roadmap, numbered labels, or transitions between arguments.

time_management_notes.description: Observations regarding time pacing across speech sections if timestamps permit.

strengths.description: Concrete positive elements observed in the performance.

areas_for_improvement.description: Specific gaps or weaknesses in argumentation, rebuttal, or strategy.

actionable_suggestions.description: Direct, practical advice on what the speaker could do differently next time.

missing_debate_context.description: Debate context absent during analysis (e.g. unrecorded prior speeches, unknown POIs, unrecorded motion info slide).

insufficient_transcript_evidence.description: Moments where inaudibility, STT transcription errors, or brevity prevented confident evaluation.

uncertain_interpretations.description: Observations that are plausible but open to multiple interpretations.

unevaluated_dimensions.description: Dimensions explicitly not evaluated (e.g. style, delivery, body language, unprovided format rules).
